**Finding: Missing — post-termination transition assistance and data return (Rule TRANSITION)**

The Agreement has no exit protections. Section 6 covers only 15-day termination notice, payment of final fees, and assignment of Works in progress (repeated at the stray clause (c), p0044). Section 8 restricts Contractor's use and disclosure of Confidential Information but never requires return or destruction, and Section 4 addresses ownership only — so on exit our data could remain on RadialSpark's systems indefinitely with no migration support.

Redline validated (ok:true) and submitted: new Section 6(d) inserted after p0044 providing (i) up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates on request, (ii) return of Works, Company data and Confidential Information within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and (iii) subsequent deletion with written certification, carved back for Contractor's Information under Section 4(b) so the clause is consistent with the existing ownership bargain. Fallback of 90 days' assistance is flagged in the comment.
